text:
maria.g: Heads-up — planning a small canary for release v2.14 at 18:00 UTC. Need a quick rollout/readiness check + explicit rollback owner. See runbook: https://intranet.redwood/ops/runbooks/canary-rollback

ajay: I can be rollback owner. What are the exact exit/rollback criteria?

maria.g: Thanks @ajay. Draft criteria: 1) smoke tests fail (synth tests or blank responses) 2) error-rate > 0.5% sustained for 5m 3) p95 generation latency +40ms vs canary baseline for 10m 4) any OOMs on GPU nodes 5) key downstream integration (search, payments) errors. Thoughts?

devon: Add: if token cost per request increases > 25% for top-10 routes (we ran a budget check) — that should be a no-go.

maria.g: Good call. Also: if model outputs cause a regression on the eval suites we run nightly (safety/ci-evals) during canary window -> rollback.

kelly: Quick infra check — are we doing canary in us-west1 only? Need to confirm we won’t route EU traffic yet.

maria.g: Yes, us-west1 only for 100 users. We'll keep EU pinned to previous version.

samir: What are the exact smoke test commands and where will build logs appear?

maria.g: Smoke commands in runbook, copied below. Logs in S3 at s3://redwood-deploys/v2.14/canary/logs and Datadog dashboard: https://app.datadoghq.com/dashboard/xyz/canary-v2-14

maria.g: Smoke snippet:
```
# quick generation smoke check (python)
from redwood_sdk import Client
c = Client(api_key=LOCAL_KEY)
r = c.generate(model="v2.14-canary", prompt="Write a short haiku about latency")
assert len(r.text) > 10
```

ajay: I'll monitor the smoke runs and error budget. If any smoke assertion fails I'll trigger rollback. Who's the deploy runner?

maria.g: @devon will run the rollout. @ajay will be rollback lead. @kelly will watch infra metrics. @samir will check downstream integrations.

devon: Deploy plan:
- 18:00 start canary (10% traffic pinned to v2.14-canary)
- 18:10 run smoke battery (automated + manual test)
- 18:20 expand to 30% if green
- 18:40 full rollout if all green
If rollback triggered, command below.

devon: Rollback command (will run from release runner host):
```bash
redwood deploy rollback --service inference --to release/v2.13 --reason "canary rollback" --notify "#eng-releases"
# fallback if infra-level: kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/inference-deployment
```

maria.g: Nice. Please also annotate the rollback decision in the runbook PR so CS/SE know.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: canary rollout v2.14 at 2026-04-02T18:00:00Z by devon. Tracking ID: canary-1769123456

kelly: I'll set alerts: GPU memory OOM, node restarts, p95 > baseline +40ms, error-rate >0.5%. Tagging runbook alert thresholds.

samir: Downstream smoke: search indexing test and payments post-test will be run at +5m. I'll post results in thread.

ajay: If I call rollback, I will post: `ROLLBACK_NOW` + reason + evidence (logs/graphs). Everyone agreed?

maria.g: Agreed. Quick thumbs before we start — :thumbsup: if good.

ajay: :thumbsup:

devon: :thumbsup: starting checks at 17:50 to warm things up.

kelly: :thumbsup: alerts set.

samir: :thumbsup: I'll post downstream results in 10m.

maria.g: Thanks team — will update post-canary summary in this thread.
